## 📌 Description
Please include a summary of the change, relevant motivation, and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## 🧪 Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance optimization / benchmark enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update

## 🔍 Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary (especially in non-trivial Redis/Lua logic)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit & integration tests pass locally (`mvn clean test`)
- [ ] I have updated documentation where appropriate
- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
